dedupe_keys.name: glm aed lake and reservoir model

description: GLM-AED combines the one-dimensional General Lake Model with Aquatic EcoDynamics water-quality libraries. The University of Western Australia group publishes coupled source, prebuilt binaries and lake examples for simulating water balance, vertical mixing, ice, temperature and aquatic chemistry. Users specify lake geometry, meteorology, inflows, outflows, water-quality settings and dates; outputs are depth-resolved state series for a selected lake or reservoir. Coverage is site-specific and simulations can span seasons to decades, with vertical resolution and time step set in the configuration. The bundled code is free under GPL-3.0 and ready-to-run examples are publicly documented. A limitation is that the current 4.0.0 main-line build is a pre-release with inputs and outputs subject to change; the latest tagged stable bundle is v3.3.0 from 2022. Users should pin a source commit or tagged release and calibrate for each lake. GLM-AED supports reservoir water-quality, flood and climate studies. The catalogue's data-freshwater-watch-citizen-science-water-quality is a separate observation source that might aid validation at matching sites, but no pairing was tested. No binary or example data was downloaded.
inputs: Lake geometry, weather, inflows, outflows and water-quality parameters
